sections.description: Premium luxury resort showcase and membership enrollment for Kompong Dewa Resort. Place full event reading pages and authentic membership enrollment forms onto any WordPress page with live countdown, multi-language switcher, and ID verification without iframes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload kd-events.zip to your WordPress site via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Click Install Now and activate the plugin.
  3. All future updates can be updated with one click directly from the WordPress Plugins screen!
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • Membership Enrollment UI integration with passport scanning, multi-language switching (EN, ID, ZH), country flag selector, and direct API submission.
  • Automatic GitHub and remote update checker with one-click in-place update support.
  • Full-screen canvas template support for both Event Showcase and Membership Enrollment.
  • Auto-cleanup for legacy stuck plugin directories.
